extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where numerator and denominator both tend to 0.

extracted_concepts.name: ∞/∞ Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where numerator and denominator both tend to infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Indeterminate Forms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit forms that are undefined and need rewriting.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product form 0·∞ rewritten as a quotient.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Difference of infinities combined into fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value approached by a function or sequence.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expression f'(x)/g'(x) used in L'Hôpital's Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taking logarithms to convert powers into products.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction Combination
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Algebraic combination of fractions to resolve ∞-∞.

extracted_concepts.name: Existence of Derivative Ratio Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Condition that lim f'(x)/g'(x) exists.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor's Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expansion of f(x) near a using derivatives plus remainder.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Infinite series expansion of a function about a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Maclaurin Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taylor series centered at a = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finite polynomial part of a Taylor expansion.

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder Term R_n
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Term R_n measuring error in Taylor approximation.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First-order linear approximation using derivative at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives beyond the first order.

extracted_concepts.name: Accuracy
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Degree to which approximation matches the function.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximation of a function by a polynomial.

extracted_concepts.name: Convergence Interval
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interval of x values where a series converges.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Series e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series e^x = Σ x^n/n!.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Series sin x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series sin x = Σ (-1)^n x^(2n+1)/(2n+1)!.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series 1/(1-x)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series 1/(1-x) = Σ x^n for |x| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Series ln(1+x)
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maclaurin series ln(1+x) = Σ (-1)^(n-1)x^n/n.
